subject: HelioGrid POC Kickoff — success metrics, eval prompts, and access checklist
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Selena Ortiz <selena@heliogrid.com>, Tom Kim <tom.kim@heliogrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: HelioGrid POC Kickoff — success metrics, eval prompts, and access checklist

Hi Selena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed kickoff plan so we can lock the next steps. I tried to keep this concise and actionable.

Pain points you shared
- High latency for inference on existing self-hosted endpoints during peak traffic (95th percentile spikes to ~750ms).
- Inconsistent output for structured-legal extraction tasks (precision variability across prompts).
- Cost and ops overhead from manual batching and model selection.

Goals for the 4-week POC
- Achieve 95th-percentile inference latency under 300ms for the high-priority flow (50-token avg).
- Reduce extraction regression rate by 30% on the canonical dataset (measured by our eval rubric).
- Demonstrate predictable cost per 1M tokens using Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Scope and deliverables
1) Two serving endpoints: (a) low-latency priority path, (b) high-throughput bulk path.
2) Prompt evaluation suite: we will run the attached sample_prompt_set.csv and a small eval harness to measure precision/recall.
3) Access & infra: Redwood will provision a sandbox project and request an AWS role for test ingestion.
4) Weekly checkpoints + final acceptance criteria review.

Owners
- Redwood: Logan Wright (eng/program lead), Ben Carter (infrastructure & provisioning), Grace O'Connor (success/evals).
- HelioGrid: Selena Ortiz (product owner), Tom Kim (platform/infra), Maria Perez (procurement, cc'd once confirmed).

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (prep): this week — finalize kickoff date and access (AWS role, sample data).
- Week 1: kickoff (provisioning + baseline runs).
- Weeks 2–3: prompt/eval iterations & performance tuning.
- Week 4: acceptance tests and handoff.

Access/setup checklist (what we need from HelioGrid)
- Temporary S3 bucket or secure link to a ~10k-row sample dataset (anonymized).
- IAM role or cross-account credentials with read-only access to the sample bucket.
- Allowlist for Redwood sandbox IPs (I’ll send the IP block tomorrow).
- Contact for procurement (PO/SOW) — Maria Perez seems like the right person; please confirm.

Attachments included: heliogrid_poc_scope_v1.pdf (overview), sample_prompt_set.csv (first-pass prompts + labels).

Proposed kickoff date: Mon, Apr 26 — does that work for your team?

Next step from us: if Apr 26 works we’ll send a short kickoff agenda and IAM role instructions by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Selena Ortiz <selena@heliogrid.com>

Subject: Re: HelioGrid POC Kickoff — success metrics, eval prompts, and access checklist

Hi Logan / team —

Appreciate the clear recap and checklist. A few quick items from our side:
- Apr 26 works for our kickoff — let's plan 10:00am PT.
- For the latency target: our top-priority production flow would ideally be under 250ms (95th) — can Redwood confirm feasibility on a small sandbox run? If not, 300ms is acceptable as a stretch target.
- Procurement lead is Maria Perez (maria.perez@heliogrid.com). She will handle SOW/PO and NDA/DocuSign.
- We will provide an anonymized sample dataset by Thu EOD (we'll upload to a temporary S3 location).

Also: can you confirm how you measure "extraction regression rate"? We want the eval rubric before the kickoff so our SMEs can review.

Thanks — will loop Maria once she responds.

Best,
Selena
Selena Ortiz
Head of Product, HelioGrid
selena@heliogrid.com | +1 (212) 555-0123

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Selena Ortiz <selena@heliogrid.com>, Tom Kim <tom.kim@heliogrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T19:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioGrid POC Kickoff — success metrics, eval prompts, and access checklist

Thanks Selena — great questions. Quick confirmations and the action list before kickoff.

On latency: we can run a baseline sandbox test during Week 1 to validate whether the 250ms 95th target is achievable with the suggested model family and the optimizations we plan to apply (continuous batching + KV caching + quantized runtime). We will confirm baseline numbers within 48 hours of provisioning.

On extraction regression metric: our approach is in the attached sample_prompt_set.csv and the eval rubric in the kickoff agenda. In short we run labeled prompts through each config and compute precision/recall on the labeled fields; regression rate is the relative increase in false negatives/positives vs your baseline (we'll share the exact script we use).

Confirmed kickoff: Mon Apr 26, 10:00am PT — invite to follow once we lock the calendar.

Action items (owner — due)
- HelioGrid: upload anonymized sample dataset to S3 and share bucket path + IAM principal (Tom) — due Thu Apr 22 EOD.
- HelioGrid: confirm procurement contact and any legal/NDAs (Selena / Maria) — due Fri Apr 23.
- Redwood: provision sandbox project + send IP allowlist and IAM role instructions (Ben) — due Fri Apr 23.
- Redwood: finalize kickoff agenda + eval rubric doc and share (Grace) — due Fri Apr 23.

I'll attach a short kickoff agenda now (redwood_kickoff_agenda.docx) — please review and flag anything missing.

See you all on Apr 26.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
